title: Octobers Very Own Yoga Class 2
long_description:
YOGA • VIBES • COMMUNITY

About this Event

Octobers Very Own Yoga Class

Come stretch, strengthen, and reconnect with yourself and your community.
Expect:
Stretching, strength & flowA curated playlist of Drake favoritesA photo worthy moment to capture the experienceWellness goodies & surprisesA special birthday touch for those celebrating another trip around the sun this OctoberGood energy, good people & good vibesMats will be provided.
All levels are welcome, whether you're a longtime yogi or simply looking for a fun new way to move.
Meet Your Instructor, Arielle
Arielle is a Physical Therapist, certified yoga instructor, and lifelong dancer with a passion for movement, wellness, and creating spaces where people can feel strong, confident, and connected to their bodies.
With a background in dance, physical therapy, and yoga, Arielle brings a unique movement focused approach to her classes, blending mindful movement, strength, mobility, and a little fun.

October Birthday Perk
Celebrating a birthday this October? Your celebration starts here! The first 10 October birthday guests can reserve a discounted ticket to October’s Very Own Yoga Class.
Use code OVO at checkout to claim your discounted ticket. Valid ID showing an October birthday will be required at check in. One ticket per person.
